response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"HTML paragraph beginning “The cowering beliefs…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“faithless fear”","suggested_fix":"Replace “بے ایمانی کا خوف” with “ایمان سے خالی خوف” to convey fear rooted in lack of faith, not dishonesty.","translation_quote":"“بے ایمانی کا خوف”"},{"location":"HTML paragraph beginning “Goliath had automatically assumed…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“…could sling stones at an hair breadth, and not miss…”","suggested_fix":"Replace “بال کی نوک پر پتھر مار سکتا تھا” with wording that conveys striking a target within a hair’s breadth without missing, such as “بال جتنے باریک نشانے پر پتھر مار سکتا تھا اور چوک نہیں سکتا تھا”.","translation_quote":"“…بال کی نوک پر پتھر مار سکتا تھا اور چوک نہیں سکتا تھا…”"},{"location":"HTML paragraph beginning “Faithful Action is inevitable…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“when our bodies are subject to our soul and spirit, and they are under the direction of God’s Spirit”","suggested_fix":"Preserve the distinction between soul and spirit; replace “ہماری روح اور باطن کے تابع ہوں” with “ہماری جان اور روح کے تابع ہوں” (or another clear Urdu rendering of “soul and spirit”).","translation_quote":"“جب ہمارے جسم ہماری روح اور باطن کے تابع ہوں”"},{"location":"HTML paragraph beginning “Some believe that being proactive…”","severity":"minor","source_quote":"“the sons of Sceva”","suggested_fix":"Correct the name to the conventional Urdu form for Sceva, for example “سکیوا کے بیٹے”.","translation_quote":"“سکّوہ کے بیٹوں”"}],"passed":false,"score":87}
